pages.text: A $(item)Microwave Radio$() links two or more sites over $(item)microwave dishes$(). It carries:$(li)APRS between $(l:radiocraft:digital/aprs)H19 terminals$(/l) (the far one sends it on again)$(li)$(l:radiocraft:direction_finding/fixes)direction finder bearings$(/l)$(li)$(l:radiocraft:telephones/telephone)telephone calls$(/l)$(br)Stations join it by touching it or by $(l:radiocraft:radios/data_wire)data wire$(/l); so do the site's other microwave radios. Dishes go on its coax.

pages.name: Microwave site
pages.text: Solar power runs the radio; coax takes it to the dish, and a $(l:radiocraft:telephones/pabx)Phone PABX$(/l) touching it serves a telephone on its $(l:radiocraft:radios/data_wire)data wire$(/l), fed by a branch of the power wire. Build the far site the same way, its dish turned back towards this one.

pages.title: Setting up
pages.text: It runs on power (26 FE/t while on). Press POWER, then SETUP: [C] a call sign, [I] a four digit ID, [F] a frequency from 5925 to 7125 MHz in 10 MHz steps. Each call sign and ID pair can only be used once.$(br2)Both ends of a link must be on the same frequency.

pages.title: Linking
pages.text: One end is the $(thing)master$(): on STATUS press [B] to broadcast. The others are $(thing)subscribers$(): press [S] to search, and [Y] to confirm the master it finds. A master can have many subscribers, and they reach each other through it.$(br2)A confirmed subscriber finds its master again on its own after a restart. Both ends must be loaded.
